title: Sharia weights and measures expressed in modern units
question: What are the amounts of the ṣāʿ, the mudd, the mile, the farsakh, the qafīz, the wasq, the nisab of gold and silver, the blood money, and so on, in modern weights and measures?
answer:
The amounts of the sharia weights and measures in modern measurement may be seen in the table below.

Ṣāʿ: 3.184272 kilograms = 8 raṭl = 4 mudd = 273 tolas = 1040 dirhams
Mudd: 796.068 grams = 2 raṭl = 68.25 tolas = 260 dirhams
Raṭl: 398.034 grams = ½ mudd = 34.125 tolas = 130 dirhams
Wasq (60 ṣāʿ): 191.05632 kilograms = 480 raṭl = 240 mudd = 16380 tolas = 62400 dirhams
Tola: 11.664 grams = 3.8095 dirhams
Qafīz (12 ṣāʿ)*: 38.211264 kilograms = 96 raṭl = 48 mudd = 3276 tolas = 12480 dirhams

* حاشية الهداية: ۳/۲٤: وفي بعض كتب اللغة أن القفيز مكيال قدر اثنا عشر صاعاً.

Dirham: 3.0618 grams of silver
Mithqāl, dīnār: 4.374 grams
Nisab of gold: 87.48 grams of gold = 20 dinars = 7½ tolas of gold
Nisab of silver: 612.35 grams of silver = 200 dirhams = 52½ tolas of silver
Qīrāṭ: 218.7 milligrams
Minimum mahr (dower): 30.618 grams of silver = 10 dirhams = 2.625 tolas of silver = 31.5 māshas
Mahr fāṭimī (1): 1530 grams 900 milligrams = 500 dirhams = 131.25 tolas of silver
Diyah (blood money): 30.618 kilograms of silver = 10000 dirhams = 2625 tolas of silver
Ūqiyyah: 122.472 grams = 40 dirhams = 10.5 tolas

The table above has been drawn up according to the reckoning of the sharia weights. Aḥsan al-Fatāwā: 4/93 gives the same reckoning, except that it differs over the well-known reckoning of the dirham. According to Aḥsan al-Fatāwā, therefore, the table would be as follows:

Dirham: 3.402 grams
Dīnār: 4.86 grams
Nisab of gold: 87.480 grams = 20 dinars = 7½ tolas of gold (2)
Nisab of silver: 612.35 grams = 200 dirhams = 52½ tolas (3)
Qīrāṭ: 0.2394 grams
Minimum mahr: 34.02 grams = 10 dirhams = 2.916 tolas
Mahr of the daughters of the Prophet ﷺ, commonly known as the mahr fāṭimī (4): 1632.96 grams = 480 dirhams = 140 tolas
Mahr of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ (5): 1701 grams = 500 dirhams = 145.83 tolas
Diyah: 34.02 kilograms = 10000 dirhams = 2916.66 tolas
Ūqiyyah: 136.08 grams = 40 dirhams = 11.67 tolas

(1) According to our fatwa the mahr fāṭimī is 480 dirhams; for the details see Kitāb al-Nikāḥ, Bāb al-Mahr. (2) and (3): the well-known view has been adopted here out of caution.

(٤) عن ابن عباس أن النبي ﷺ حين زوج علياً فاطمة، قال: يا علي لا تدخل على أهلك حتى تقدم لهم شيئاً، فقال: مالي شيء يا رسول الله! قال: أعطها درعك الحطمية، قال ابن أبي رواد: فقومت الدرع أربعمائة وثمانين درهماً. رواه الطبراني في الأوسط والكبير باختصاره، وفيه سعيد بن زنبور ولم أجد من ترجمه وبقية رجاله ثقات. (مجمع الزوائد: ٤/ ۲۸۳).

(۵) عن أبي سلمة قال: سألت عائشة رضي الله تعالى عنها، كم كان صداق نساء النبي ﷺ؟ قالت: كان صداقه في أزواجه اثنتي عشرة أوقية ونشّاً. هل تدري ما النّش؟ هو نصف أوقية، وذلك خمسمائة درهم. (رواه ابن ماجه: ۱/ ۱۳۵).

Gaz (yard): 0.9144 metres
Dhirāʿ: 48.72 centimetres
Sharia mile: 1.8288000 kilometres = 2000 gaz = 1.1363636 English miles
English mile: 1.6093440 kilometres = 1760 gaz = 0.8800 sharia mile
Farsakh: 5.4864 kilometres = 6000 gaz = 3.4090908 English miles = 3 sharia miles
Distance at which the prayer is shortened: 77.248512 kilometres = 84480 gaz = 48 English miles = 42.24 sharia miles

That is roughly 78 kilometres. Most of the senior scholars (may Allah have mercy on them) adopted this view.

Then there is 45 sharia miles, that is 82.296 kilometres. This is the position given as the fatwa by the imams of Khwārazm, and other scholars have adopted it; but they have fixed it at 78 kilometres, whereas converting 45 sharia miles directly into kilometres gives a figure somewhat above 82 kilometres.

And there is 48 sharia miles, that is 87.7824 kilometres. Some scholars have adopted this view.

Irdabb: 76.422528 kilograms = 24 ṣāʿ = 12 faraq = 2 qafīz = 96 mudd = 6552 tolas = 192 raṭl = 24960 dirhams
Jadīb: 152.845056 kilograms = 48 ṣāʿ = 24 faraq = 4 qafīz = 192 mudd = 13104 tolas = 384 raṭl = 49920 dirhams
Ḥiml: 191.05632 kilograms = 60 ṣāʿ = 30 faraq = 5 qafīz = 240 mudd = 1 wasq = 16380 tolas = 480 raṭl = 62400 dirhams
Faraq: 6.368544 kilograms = 2 ṣāʿ = 8 mudd = 546 tolas = 16 raṭl = 2080 dirhams
Faraq: 206.97768 kilograms = 65 ṣāʿ = 260 mudd = 17745 tolas = 520 raṭl = 67600 dirhams
Qullah: 6.368544 kilograms = 2 ṣāʿ = 8 mudd = 546 tolas = 16 raṭl = 2080 dirhams
ʿAraq: 47.76408 kilograms = 15 ṣāʿ = 60 mudd = 4095 tolas = 120 raṭl = 15600 dirhams
Miktal: 47.76408 kilograms = 15 ṣāʿ = 60 mudd = 4095 tolas = 120 raṭl = 15600 dirhams
Kurr: 2292.67584 kilograms = 720 ṣāʿ = 360 faraq = 60 qafīz = 2880 mudd = 12 wasq = 196560 tolas = 5760 raṭl = 748800 dirhams
Kaylajah: 1.4926275 kilograms = 1⅞ mudd = 127.969 tolas = 3.75 raṭl = 487.5 dirhams
Kūz: 4.776408 kilograms = 1½ ṣāʿ = 6 mudd = 409.5 tolas = 12 raṭl = 1560 dirhams
Makkūk: 4.776408 kilograms = 1½ ṣāʿ = 6 mudd = 409.5 tolas = 12 raṭl = 1560 dirhams
Jawzah: 17.496 grams = 4 mithqāls
Ḥuzmah: 17.496 grams = 4 mithqāls
Dāniq: 0.5103 grams = 1/6 dirham
Ṭasūj: 0.127575 grams = ¼ dāniq
Nashsh: 61.236 grams = 20 dirhams = half an ūqiyyah
Barīd: 21.9456 kilometres = 24000 gaz = 4 farsakh = 13.6363632 English miles = 12 sharia miles
Ḥabl: 487.2 centimetres = 5.328 gaz = 10 dhirāʿ

These figures have been worked out on the basis of:

"المقاييس والمقادير عند العرب" الشهيدة النسيبه محمد فتحي الحريري،

واللہ سبحانہ و تعالی اعلم
